reconcile.note: Gill reads Revelation's unnamed name as a distinct divine title, Immanuel or Son of God, not a denial that Jesus has any other known name.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible lists Revelation's unknown name beside the New Testament's many recorded titles for Jesus as a plain self-contradiction.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: You shall call his name Jesus
sides.verseText: She shall bring forth a son. You shall call his name Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.\"

sides.snippet: a name written which no one knows but he himself.
sides.verseText: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.
